turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are. Who decided Owen gets a zero?
I'm sitting. Who decided on the zero, and when?
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
We haven't spoken on the phone; nobody from this school called me before that zero went in. Who decided?
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.
No. On what basis, and is a checker score all you have?
